get_agent_context.description: Read your authenticated principal, customer scope, mandate summary, effective per-order and rolling 24-hour limits, remaining budget, environment, rate limits, standing constraints and supported operations. Advisory snapshot: authority is revalidated on each mutation. No other customer's authority is exposed.

search_products.description: Search the local catalog using AND terms and validated structured hard filters. Returns at most 10 products; mandate categories filter before the result limit; no live API calls. Exclusions require an uncontradicted free-from entry or a catalog allergen declaration not listing the code; contains, may_contain, undeclared and missing data fail. X99 is only a declaration marker. Contradicted claims fail. Customer standing constraints apply in find_offers, which is the procurement path. Buyer authority: stdio --mandate FILE or HTTP Agent-Mandate plus the agent credential. EdDSA VC-JWT issuer/signature/nbf/exp/revocation/sub/customer/category checks run on every step; MANDATE_INVALID names the failed check. Buyer authority works without a policy agent row; policy only tightens its per-order and daily limits and autonomy. Levels: approval_required (default when omitted) and autonomous_within_limits; the stricter buyer/policy level wins. approval_required adds autonomy_level and routes otherwise acceptable orders to PENDING_APPROVAL. GET /v1/agents/{id}/track-record gives advisory readiness; only an operator or the buyer_admin may POST /v1/agents/{id}/autonomy with level and reason. Quote/order bind and expose mandate metadata; human approval revalidates the original stored mandate. Without a buyer VC, policy-row behavior applies.

find_offers.description: Find up to 10 ranked live priced offers for a structured need. Union current customer standing constraints with the request; effective_constraints and exclusion_counts name request/customer_policy sources and evidence reasons. Decisions screens the catalog pool when configured; screened_count counts actual submissions (including failed requests), zero when skipped. Then one price and stock batch checks suitable products up to shortlist.live_max (default 25). Rank orderable offers first, then scored before unscored, then preference matches before substitutes. Unknown-size offers retain SIZE_UNKNOWN and compare their known sales-unit prices separately. Pack conversion uses Decimal arithmetic and six-decimal sizes; CASE content includes its multiplier once. Every sales quantity is whole, including KG: allowedLotSize below one counts as one. Price factor uses purchase_total (whole packs), overbuy {amount, unit} states excess, score_breakdown exposes weighted factors; unit_price is per sales unit. Reliability is absolute and CO2 uses the global catalog range; missing values use neutral catalog medians. Plans use ALL ranked priced offers before the returned slice, with fill and cheapest-split searches sharing a 20,000-node budget and valid greedy fallbacks, without extra calls; previews include mandate and daily limits. Placement rechecks stock/policy. Explicit search_terms use AND; otherwise intent uses AND, broadening only empty results deterministically to meaningful OR words and hyphenated parts. RETRIEVAL_BROADENED names tried words; POOL_TRUNCATED discloses unscreened matches. Returns retrieval {mode, terms_used}, matched_count, screened_count, priced_count, lookup_id, evidence, provenance, fit, stock and single/split/partial plans. no_match_reason explains empty hard-filter results and suggests search_terms after empty broadening. NeedSpec.supplier_id defaults to valio; nordfood is a synthetic case-priced supplier. A stored need_ref binds the supplier through quote and order; GET /v1/suppliers advertises capabilities. Supplier restrictions in policy and buyer VC supplier_ids apply before lookup and on commitment. EUR-only policy refuses SEK with UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY. Orders expose execution.mode/status/supplier_ref/acknowledged_at. Valio is gateway-simulated. Nordfood becomes supplier-acknowledged only after its service accepts; PENDING_EXECUTION with next_action RETRY_SAME_COMMAND means repeat place_order with exactly the same idempotency key to reconcile an uncertain submit. Sandbox is a separate deployment with sandbox-only credentials and storage, fixture provenance, environment=sandbox signed artifacts and UBL labels. Sandbox reset expires outstanding promises with reason sandbox_reset; admin routes require the sandbox admin credential. Warnings: PARTIAL_STOCK means insufficient on-time sales units; DATE_SHIFT means delivery after the deadline; CUTOFF_PASSED means the order cut-off for the accompanying delivery date has passed, and requires approval; cache hits advance the fetched supplier time by monotonic cache age, preserving fetched-at provenance. SALES_BLOCK means not for sale; NOT_AVAILABLE means empty schedule lines and rejects by default; UNKNOWN_PRODUCT is a valid legacy policy code, no longer emitted. AVAILABILITY_UNCONFIRMED means a usable schedule amount >=999999: stock unknown, ignored by default. When on time, any quantity is orderable, available_amount=null, availability_known=false, with no local reservation. Later unknown stock leaves finite on-time stock known and reserved. The amount rule applies to every logistic model; delivery dates, sales blocks and units still apply. PRICE_ERROR means invalid/unavailable price; SIZE_UNKNOWN means no unit conversion; SIZE_MISMATCH means pack content differs from the live price ratio or explicit name-count evidence by more than 3% and requires review; OUTSIDE_PREFERENCE marks substitutes and lists differences from soft brand, price, pack-size or label preferences; these need approval by default. NO_FIT_SCORE means unavailable Decisions probability; AVAILABILITY_ERROR means stock is unverified. Hard constraints and sale blocks cannot be overridden by fit scores. SIZE_UNCONFIRMED, UNIT_MISMATCH (zero usable amount), STOCK_MODEL_UNKNOWN and CUTOFF_UNKNOWN require review; Name sizes require a confirming live ratio within 3%, matching explicit catalog content within 3%, one count expression matching the sales multiplier without contradictory measures, or a single measure at multiplier 1. Otherwise size_per_sales_unit and units_needed are display estimates from the smallest plausible candidate and SIZE_UNCONFIRMED prevents autonomous placement. Spec 15 also requires SIZE_UNCONFIRMED for catalog/name sizes without a confirming live ratio. name_size_candidates lists every candidate with original source_text and local expression. Explicit package totals are never multiplied by portion counts; repeated complete pack expressions stay independent, and slash portion counts are retained (100 pieces / 25 per 625g pack = 2.5kg). NO_STOCK rejects zero-stock products with no delivery date. Missing/zero/negative prices or missing currency give PRICE_ERROR. VARIABLE_WEIGHT (final price follows delivered weight) and DEPOSIT (details supplied) are informational. All warnings fail closed to approval unless explicitly ignored by policy; protected evidence warnings cannot be ignored. Naive closingTime uses Europe/Helsinki. Missing reliability/CO2 is neutral, not proof. Buyer authority: stdio --mandate FILE or HTTP Agent-Mandate plus the agent credential. EdDSA VC-JWT issuer/signature/nbf/exp/revocation/sub/customer/category checks run on every step; MANDATE_INVALID names the failed check. Buyer authority works without a policy agent row; policy only tightens its per-order and daily limits and autonomy. Levels: approval_required (default when omitted) and autonomous_within_limits; the stricter buyer/policy level wins. approval_required adds autonomy_level and routes otherwise acceptable orders to PENDING_APPROVAL. GET /v1/agents/{id}/track-record gives advisory readiness; only an operator or the buyer_admin may POST /v1/agents/{id}/autonomy with level and reason. Quote/order bind and expose mandate metadata; human approval revalidates the original stored mandate. Without a buyer VC, policy-row behavior applies.

create_quote.description: Recheck live price and stock for selected lines or a stored fulfilment plan, then lock fixed net EUR prices until expires_at (at most 30 minutes). Supply exactly one of lines or plan_ref {lookup_id, plan_index}; plan_index is zero-based, need_ref defaults to the plan lookup. Explicit lines REQUIRE need_ref to a stored lookup, otherwise 422 NEED_REF_REQUIRED. Current customer standing constraints are unioned with the stored request at quotation, placement and approval. Partial-plan uncovered warnings persist into ordering. Registered agents may quote only for customers in their mandate (CUSTOMER_NOT_IN_MANDATE); unregistered agents receive AGENT_NOT_REGISTERED on lookup, quote and order. Quantities are strict numbers >0 and <=1,000,000 in whole sales units, including KG. allowedLotSize below one counts as one; fractional quantities return 422 INVALID_LOT_SIZE naming the step. Invalid price or missing currency prevents quoting. Customer and delivery date must match the stored need. Ed25519 detached JWS over the spec 10/13 RFC 8785 quote_payload with decimal-string quantities/money and provenance; protected quote_version=2 and quote_integrity authenticate immutable evidence separately from the promise payload. Earlier unversioned signatures remain usable until expiry; kid names a public key at /.well-known/jwks.json. Offline: scripts/verify_quote.py quote.json --jwks jwks.json --customer ID. price_commitment=gateway-locked. Cached command replays revalidate the bound mandate and customer scope. Derived forward navigation lists in links are outside immutable signed evidence. No negotiation. Buyer authority: stdio --mandate FILE or HTTP Agent-Mandate plus the agent credential. EdDSA VC-JWT issuer/signature/nbf/exp/revocation/sub/customer/category checks run on every step; MANDATE_INVALID names the failed check. Buyer authority works without a policy agent row; policy only tightens its per-order and daily limits and autonomy. Levels: approval_required (default when omitted) and autonomous_within_limits; the stricter buyer/policy level wins. approval_required adds autonomy_level and routes otherwise acceptable orders to PENDING_APPROVAL. GET /v1/agents/{id}/track-record gives advisory readiness; only an operator or the buyer_admin may POST /v1/agents/{id}/autonomy with level and reason. Quote/order bind and expose mandate metadata; human approval revalidates the original stored mandate. Without a buyer VC, policy-row behavior applies.

place_order.description: Accept an unexpired fixed-price quote. Ordering requires a mandate: unregistered agents receive AGENT_NOT_REGISTERED with no order or reservation created. Lookup and quote also require a mandate. Registered agents must stay in customer scope, below the lower of global and mandate per-order limits, and within a cumulative rolling 24-hour autonomous spend limit; cancelled and human-approved orders are excluded. Rechecks stock and policy; returns CONFIRMED, PENDING_APPROVAL or REJECTED with every rule hit. Retry with the same idempotency_key to get the saved first response, even after cancellation, after ownership and identity checks (PENDING_EXECUTION resumes ambiguous supplier execution per spec 25), even for legacy quotes or retired signing keys; an order-bound buyer mandate is always revalidated, including on headerless retries. EXPIRED_QUOTE requires a new quote. Human approval is REST-only in the inbox, optionally bound to evidence_revision. Changed evidence stays pending with 409 EVIDENCE_CHANGED; a human must review the refreshed revision and use a new approval idempotency key before approving again. No upstream order endpoint exists. Buyer authority: stdio --mandate FILE or HTTP Agent-Mandate plus the agent credential. EdDSA VC-JWT issuer/signature/nbf/exp/revocation/sub/customer/category checks run on every step; MANDATE_INVALID names the failed check. Buyer authority works without a policy agent row; policy only tightens its per-order and daily limits and autonomy. Levels: approval_required (default when omitted) and autonomous_within_limits; the stricter buyer/policy level wins. approval_required adds autonomy_level and routes otherwise acceptable orders to PENDING_APPROVAL. GET /v1/agents/{id}/track-record gives advisory readiness; only an operator or the buyer_admin may POST /v1/agents/{id}/autonomy with level and reason. Quote/order bind and expose mandate metadata; human approval revalidates the original stored mandate. Without a buyer VC, policy-row behavior applies.

get_order_ubl.description: Export this agent's own order as UBL 2.1 XML, identical to GET /v1/orders/{id}/ubl. document=order (default) or response; response codes AP confirmed, RE rejected/cancelled/expired, CA pending. Includes sales-unit GTINs and UN/ECE unit codes. Party endpoint placeholders need data from Valio Aimo; gateway-simulated, no supplier transmission. Another agent's order is ORDER_NOT_FOUND.

cancel_order.description: Cancel only a CONFIRMED order owned by the authenticated HTTP principal or the stdio --agent-id, before every known line cutoff. Lines without a cutoff do not block. Releases local stock reservations, records the reason and actor, and leaves fixed prices unchanged. No upstream calls. ORDER_NOT_FOUND (404) hides another agent's order; INVALID_TRANSITION or CUTOFF_PASSED rejects ineligible orders.

available_amount.description: On-time sales units after local reservations; null when a usable on-time upstream amount >= 999999 means unknown but orderable.
available_amount.title: Available Amount

availability_known.description: False for usable on-time upstream amounts >= 999999, independently of logistic model; no local reservation is counted. Later unknown stock does not exempt finite on-time stock from reservations.
availability_known.title: Availability Known

coverage.description: Fraction of requested sales units covered by on-time stock.
coverage.title: Coverage
